vulnerable_code:
class Imaging::ScansController < ApplicationController
  def view_blob
    # Resolves signed blob id and issues direct redirect without verifying patient/practitioner authorization
    blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.find_signed!(params[:signed_id])
    redirect_to rails_blob_url(blob, disposition: 'inline')
  end
end
diagnosis: The view_blob action resolves ActiveStorage::Blob using signed_id and redirects to the underlying storage URL without verifying that current_user has medical authorization to inspect the scan's parent record. Attackers possessing or enumerating signed tokens can access confidential MRI and CT DICOM diagnostic images.

corrected_code:
class Imaging::ScansController < ApplicationController
  def view_blob
    blob = ActiveStorage::Blob.find_signed!(params[:signed_id])
    scan = MedicalScan.find_by!(dicom_blob_id: blob.id)
    authorize scan, :view?

    redirect_to rails_blob_url(blob, disposition: 'inline')
  end
end
